Amanda: quick heads-up — ran zone-hop overnight comparing L4 / T4 / A10G for small-chat and embeddings (short prompts, batch=1..8). dropping raw notes here.
Rui: awesome, thanks. any failures or just perf/noise?
Amanda: mostly perf + a couple of weird latency spikes in ap-south region. no OOMs. quant levels: fp16, int8-ptq.
Sam: did you test kernel variants (fused-attn vs generic) per GPU?
Amanda: yes. default kernel selector -> a10g favours fused-attn, l4 picks optimized fp kernels, t4 falls back more often to generic on longer seqs.
Deepa: what seq length and prompt mix for small-chat?
Amanda: median seq=64, p95=220. small-chat dataset = 1k queries (mix of code/qa/short-chitchat). embeddings run = 10k sentences, avg len 32 tokens.
bench-bot: summary uploaded -> https://internal/redwood/bench/1748001234
infra-bot: note: spot capacity in eu-west was reclaimed at 03:14 UTC, some runs re-routed to west-us temporarily.
Rui: can you paste key numbers? latency p50/p95 and throughput end-to-end (tokens/s)?
Amanda: paste below (small-chat, batch=1):
```
A10G (fp16, fused): p50 42ms p95 110ms
L4  (fp16, opt):   p50 55ms p95 150ms
T4  (fp16, generic): p50 78ms p95 280ms
```
Amanda: embeddings (batch=8, int8-ptq):
```
A10G: 4800 embed/sec
L4:   3600 embed/sec
T4:   2200 embed/sec
```
Deepa: interesting that L4 sits closer to A10G on embeddings vs chat.
Sam: kernel note: for L4 we saw a ~10% improvement when forcing the new kv-shrink kernel and enabling async-copy.
Rui: did quant degrade quality on small-chat? any regression numbers?
Amanda: int8-ptq kept chrF/bleu-ish metrics within 0.8% for embeddings; small-chat had a few edgecases — contrived prompts produced hallucination increase in ~12 examples out of 1k.
Deepa: can you attach examples? we should add to regression harness.
Amanda: added 12 toxic/halluc examples to /evals/regressions/1748001234 (link in bot summary).
infra-bot: routing heatmap in the summary shows ap-south spikes correlate with kernel fallbacks and >p95 seq lengths.
Sam: mitigation idea: pin L4 small-chat to opt-fp kernel and add a short-seq fallback to A10G for p95+ requests in ap-south.
Rui: cost estimates? how large is unit cost delta across GPUs for these workloads?
Amanda: rough on-demand cost:$
A10G ~ 3.2x baseline
L4   ~ 2.1x baseline
T4   ~ 1.0x baseline
But per-token cost after batching/kv-cache shifts A10G -> ~1.6x vs T4 for high-traffic steady-state small-chat.
Deepa: so for latency-sensitive p50 targets, A10G wins. for cheap bulk embedding throughput, L4 is sweet spot.
Sam: any kernel scheduling oddities across zones? like different drivers / cuda versions?
Amanda: yes — ap-south had older driver (470.x) and that forced some kernels to generic path. eu-west/us had 515+ and fused-attn worked fine.
Rui: ops action: schedule driver upgrade in ap-south, or add guardrail that redirects small-chat p95 to eu-west when latency budget tight.
Deepa: prefer driver upgrade if customers require consistent perf in ap-south.
Sam: also we should add an autoscale policy tuning: increase burst capacity for small-chat by 15% during peak to avoid fallbacks.
Amanda: added TODOs in bench doc: 1) add regression examples to evals, 2) try calibration-aware quant for the 12 bad cases, 3) test driver upgrade in staging, 4) experiment forcing kv-shrink on L4 at scale.
Rui: thanks, can someone run a short A/B where we route 10% of ap-south traffic to eu-west A10G to measure real-world user latency delta?
Sam: I'll spin that up today, 10% sampling for 2 hours.
Amanda: GH issue created: #eng-ml/174800-zonehop (contains results + links)
Deepa: sweet. one more ask: add a tiny cost/perf matrix for BU owners (simple row per gpu, columns: p50,p95,embed/sec,cost-index).
Amanda: will do, ping me if you want entries.
Rui: solid thread. low-noise, actionable. thanks all :thumbsup:
bench-bot: archived bench artifacts and CSVs -> s3://redwood-bench/1748001234/
Amanda: done for now, will follow up after driver update tests.
